rows.ARS:
Pink blend Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Wedding Bells ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Tim Hermann Kordes (Germany, 2001).
Introduced in Germany by W. Kordes' Söhne (Retail) in 2010 as 'Wedding Bells'.
rows.Bloom: Pink. Moderate, myrrh, rose fragrance. 40 to 55 petals. Average diameter 4". Large, very full (41+ petals), borne mostly solitary, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Long, pointed, ovoid buds.
rows.Habit:
Bushy, upright. Semi-glossy, dark green foliage. 5 leaflets.

Height: up to 32" (up to 80cm). Width: up to 20" (up to 50cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 5a and warmer. Disease susceptibility: blackspot resistant.
rows.Patents:

The new variety of rose plant of the present invention originated from a controlled crossing in a breeding program of two distinct parents during the summer of 2001. The crossing was between an ‘un-named seedling’ and an ‘un-named seedling’.
